 Advertisement In-N-Out CEO says Oklahoma is among states eyed for expansion
 Could In-N-Out be coming to Oklahoma? The chain's CEO says the state is among a handful being eyed for expansion.
 Advertisement Updated: 6:09 PM CDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Addison Kliewer Special Projects Producer/Digital Editor In-N-Out CEO says Oklahoma is among states eyed for expansion
 Could In-N-Out be coming to Oklahoma? The chain's CEO says the state is among a handful being eyed for expansion.
 Updated: 6:09 PM CDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Addison Kliewer Special Projects Producer/Digital Editor Could In-N-Out be coming to Oklahoma? 
 >> Open the video player above for more top headlines. 
 Advertisement The California-based fast-food chain's owner and president, Lynsi Snyder, said in a video posted to In-N-Out's website that the chain is considering expanding in three states: Oklahoma, Arkansas and Mississippi.
 She did not say whether there were any active conversations about where and when an In-N-Out could be coming to Oklahoma. 
 The closest In-N-Out for Oklahomans is in Denton, Texas. New Mexico is set to get its first In-N-Out next year. 
 In 2025, the company expanded to Washington and Tennessee. The chain now has locations in 10 states across the U.S. 
 Snyder said In-N-Out's supply truck travels from Texas to Tennessee, and there are states along that route that would make sense when the time comes to expand. 
 "If you look at the map, you've got Texas. There's Arkansas, Mississippi, Oklahoma. There are some states that are possibilities," Snyder said. "New Mexico has been waiting for us, and that will be soon."
 In-N-Out has more than 400 locations across the U.S.
